description: Check any Robinhood Chain token before you buy it: is it a rug, a honeypot, a scam or a copycat? Returns { status, category, rugged, dumped }: status kept_out (Trnch keeps it out of the Heat and will not trade it), in_heat, seen or unknown, with a public risk category (SCAM_CONTRACT, LINKED_TO_PAST_RUG, HEAVY_SELL_TAX, CANNOT_SELL, COORDINATED_LAUNCH, COPYCAT, LIQUIDITY_PULLED, DUMPED, OTHER_RISK; DUMPED is a coordinated dump, not a rug). unknown means not seen by Trnch, not a pass. No key needed. Also returns creator { history, tokensInHeat } or null: launch history of the token's creator (bucketed), context only, not part of the verdict. Also returns builder { source, status (SHIPPING, ACTIVE, RESUMED, QUIET, DORMANT, UNKNOWN), verifiedBuilder, lastShipAt, ships30d, appliesToToken, measured, url, asOf } or null: what HEY Research reports about the team's shipping, per HEY, separate from the verdict; not a rating or a verdict (null when HEY has nothing; ships30d null means not measured; appliesToToken false means the activity is the project's). A signal, never a guarantee. Full record: https://trnch.fun/tia
